nom: medicube Age-R Glutathione Glow Milky Toner

avis.texte: I’m obsessed with this essence! I keep an extra bottle always on hand, one in my travel kit & on autoship! No other product available on the market gives you this amazing glow. Not the highest end from AB, not any other k-beauty product, not anything from Sephora & not any other type from medicube. THIS Age-R Glutathione glow milk toner aka essence is perfection for dry to oily skin. Mature aging skin to teenagers this is the golden ticket from day to night use. I honestly did NOT want to put out a review & risk this product being another wonder from medicube, as we know how social influences can change how products are perceived. This particular essence is phenomenal & deserves its proper glory. It’s not heavy or too thick. Little light & liquidy considering the performance. You can apply by spraying on, dabbing onto a cotton round or in layers apply directly from the bottle to your hand & pat directly into the skin. It’s light & yet very hydrating. Zero stickiness, zero oily residue, this absorbs & leaves your skin looking refreshed & hydrated. AMAZING under makeup (before or after sunscreen) & truly will blow you away patted under the eye area before concealing (Nikki La Rose make-up suggestion). If you ever get dry patches from your makeup throughout the day, dab a bit of this essence & poof gone or concealed (especially in creases). I love using this after my actives at night. Before my vitamin C with a few sweeps in the mornings. I cannot emphasize out of ALL the differ

I’ve been searching for a product that delivers that glass-skin glow, and I finally found it in this toner. It makes my skin feel soft, hydrated, and noticeably radiant. I’ve also seen my pimple dark spots fade more quickly than usual, which has been a huge plus. What I love most is that it isn’t greasy or sticky—it absorbs beautifully and leaves my skin looking fresh and healthy. Every morning, I wake up with a glow that feels natural and luminous. As someone with sensitive skin, I’m impressed that this worked so well without causing irritation. Considering it’s a Korean skincare product imported from Korea, I find the price fair for the quality and results. This has quickly become a staple in my routine, and it’s one I’ll continue to repurchase again and again.

avis.titre: K-BEAUTY at it's BESTK-BEAUTY at it's BEST
avis.texte: If you have been living under a rock ( which if you live under a rock, that's pretty bad A$$), you may not have known that Korean skincare aka "K beauty" is taking over the skincare world by storm. One: Because their products work and are affective on most skin types. Two: They contain products that have shown great results in clinical studies to help with everything from wrinkles, age spots, uneven skintone, rosacea, moisture and T zone skin. ...There is a product out there for everyone. Three: They are affordable. Medicube is one of the fastest growing skincare lines on the market and they are soon to partner with high-end retailers in the US like Ulta Beauty, Macy's, Sacks, and possibly places like Target or even Walmart. With that being said... Get what you need, or try and find what works well for you now! Don't wait, I have a feeling that with these trends the prices they are offering now may not be what they will be in the near future (supply and demand people). Also, as a male, I can tell you there is nothing wrong with a good quality skincare routine. We all need to take care of the largest organ in our body, our skin! A good cleanser, toner, and moisturizer never hurt anyone lol. Medicube has a wide range of products and this one is no exception to a positive review. Peptides as well as glutathione are known to help in skin cell regeneration as well as skin lightening and brightening. Again, a nice "K beauty" routine of 3 to 7+ steps can help take years off your fac

The is the best toner I have used. My skin loves it and it has been the healthiest since I have used this. My acne marks are going away, I have a healthy glow to my skin, and it is so smooth. I feel comfortable not wearing light makeup to cover up my skin. I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Glowy and Dewy 10 /10 / best toner ever
avis.texte: Out of all the toners I’ve tried this is by far my Favorite !! The glow it gives is unreal & knocks all the others I’ve tired out of the water . From reading other reviews, people have complained of the smell , so they must have changed the composition because it does NOT have a bad smell anymore . It’s smells light & almost floral like .. and the smell dissipates fast . This is going on my repeat order . I don’t Ever want to be without . Love it way more than Numbuzin #9 , Byoma milky & so many more that I’ve tried . My face is so glowy now that I’ve been using it & I can tell the difference on the days I don’t use it . I would give it a 10 if I could . Holy Grail product 👌

My skin barrier was jacked up. My skin was dry, patchy and scaly....just gross and icky. My fur baby died after 16 yrs of love and constant companionship. So for a time, nothing mattered. The one day I caught a glimpse of this haggered wretched person staring back at me through the mirror. I remembered this product while mindlessly watching YouTube (Dr. Sam Ellis) and so very glad that I decided to order it. After the first use,I woke up to skin that felt soft, moisturized and glowed. If you could have seen and felt my skin from just the day before you would have been impressed too. It's been 2 weeks, I've mainly put it on at night after my double cleanse. Old acne scars are less noticeable, my skin tone overall is more even. My skin feels buttery soft to the touch and glows throughout the day. I've not been wearing makeup but I'm sure it will glide on with ease once do. I didn't give it 5 stars because it has fragrance and I prefer skincare without. It seemed like a small bottle but a little goes a long way and I'm excited to see continued results as I slowly make my way to the end of this bottle...so worth it, one of my new fav

The glow it leaves on the face is incredible, plus it has an exquisite scent

This one’s become part of my after-cleansing routine and I’m not mad about it. It’s a two-layer formula (essence + peptide cream) so you actually have to shake the bottle well before each use or you’re just getting one layer instead of the full thing. Once it’s mixed it goes on so smooth and gives my skin this dewy glow that sticks around. Looked into what’s actually in it and the star is glutathione, which is a well known antioxidant for brightening and evening skin tone, and this one has a pretty high concentration of it. There’s also six types of peptides in there for firmness, plus niacinamide and alpha-arbutin which both help with discoloration, and some calming botanicals like lavender water and chamomile so it’s not harsh at all. No irritation for me so far, just heads up it does have fragrance in it if that’s a thing for you. My skin tone isn’t magically even yet but I wasn’t expecting overnight results from a toner. This is more of a long game product so I’m planning to stick with it and see where my skin’s at in a few months.
I feel my skin hydrated. I would like another packaging as it may be difficult to apply.
The glow! Shake well and apply. I like to add it to a spray bottle - easy spray and go

This is the first time I’ve used a product with Glutathione in it and I haven’t been using it terribly long so I can’t speak for effectiveness on lessening the appearance of aging skin but I can say it leaves a dewy glow and absorbs well into the skin. I use under my makeup every morning.

avis.titre: Medicube AGE-R Glutathione Toner — Milky, Brightening, and Soothing
avis.texte: This milky toner has become a staple in the middle of my skin flooding routine — I apply it after my more watery toners to help lock in hydration and prep my skin for the next step. It feels rich and nourishing but still absorbs quickly, leaving my skin looking calm and subtly brightened (thank you, glutathione!). I also added a spray nozzle to the bottle for extra convenience, and that’s made it even easier to use — just a few spritzes and I’m good to go. It layers beautifully with other products and doesn’t feel heavy or sticky, even on sensitive skin days. Lovely texture, clean results, and a bottle that lasts a long time. This one is definitely a quiet gem.

This is truly one of the best toners I’ve ever used. It’s definitely my favorite out of all of my other toners. As someone with hyperpigmentation, glutathione works great to brighten dark spots, and that’s exactly what this toner does for me. Just all around brightens my skin complexion while also targeting hyperpigmentation. Not to mention it is extremely nourishing and just gives you this amazing glow, especially when combined with vitamin c. It might seem “greasy” at first however it’s not, it will absorb into your skin beautifully and sits perfectly under sunscreen and makeup. Honestly, it’s a great product that helps brighten and will enhance your glow with or without makeup
I received this today and didn’t expect the color to be just milky toned. It’s not like what’s advertised at all. I have no idea what this is. It’s going back.

This makes my skin feel absolutely amazing! I’ve only been using it a week, and I worked in aesthetics for a decade. This product is sooooo affordable and has a much more noticeable immediate effect than much more expensive products!

avis.titre: The smell alone is worth buying it but beware of FAKES
avis.texte: Excellent toner, wow. The brightening affect is immediate and it’s also very moisturizing. Smells incredible…..seriously, they should sell it as a perfume. This new bottle is nothing like another bottle I have. Color is different smell is different and thickness is different.

avis.titre: Moisturizes well.  Bit of an awkward time with the pour.
avis.texte: This comes in a skinny bottle which has a pretty small hole for pouring this out at the top; the hole is flush with the cover. This is yellow colored and basically has the consistency of milk. I'd recommend doing this over the sink your first couple times till you get the hang of pouring it, because it tends to run down the face of the lid/cover then gets into the spirals for the screw on lid. It would have been nice if they would have tapered the pour hole outward a bit so that the serum would just go straight down rather than across and into the spirals. The serum absorbed into my skin pretty quickly, and within a short period of time my skin felt plump and smooth. I couldn't really detect any sort of scent from this. One thing - this stuff will separate into layers in the bottle, especially if you keep it at a cold temp (I usually put this kinda stuff in my fridge so it stays good longer), so you will need to shake it good if you notice any layer separation. No side effects noted.

Pros: - milky texture leaves skin feeling soft and glowy - lightweight formula - pleasant scent (might not be for everyone but dissipates quickly enough) - bottle is sealed under the cap - a lot of beneficial ingredients like niacinamide, biotin, peptides, fruit & herbal extracts - full size bottle, should last a good while Cons: - difficult to dispense; I prefer to use my hands the majority of the time but this dispenses messily so best with cotton pad instead - one of the ingredients listed is "fragrance" despite all the other natural extracts

It’s the color of the insides of a banana cream pie. The liquid separates. It’s easy to shake it and have everything mix back to the way it’s supposed to be, though. It doesn’t have much of a scent. What scent it has is kind of sweet. Maybe it’s a citrus? It’s very liquid and since I shook it, it was bubbly. It spread well and doesn’t feel oily. It makes my skin shiny (glowy?). It makes my skin slightly tacky. It didn’t make my skin red or give me a rash. It didn’t sting when I put it on (but my skin wasn’t broken, either so…) There is a security seal. It’s plastic and doubles as a handle to pull the plug out of the hole. Much like!

avis.titre: Incredibly hydrating toner with loads of natural ingredients.
avis.texte: I have been wearing this toner alone this summer and it has been the perfect amount of hydration for my skin. I have dry sensitive skin that is allergic to most sunscreen. It has been hot and humid in the Southwest and this toner alone has kept my skin moisturized and hydrated. This toner has a lovely light scent of peach, melon and honeysuckle. The only thing I don't like about this toner is the dispenser. I usually wash my face clean and apply the toner directly onto my face, so I prefer a spray dispenser, mainly so that I don't lose a lot of the product in a cotton pad. Other than that, I love this toner and will definitely reorder. Another great skincare product from Korea.

avis.titre: Nice toner that creates a glow on your face
avis.texte: This is a high-quality toner in a large bottle that should last you a long time, easily several months, even with daily use. It is a toner, so expect a liquid-y consistency, rather than a cream or a serum. I would use a cotton ball to help apply it to my face rather than just trying to pour the liquid onto your hands. The scent does not linger on the face too long, so even if you are not a huge fan, don’t worry about the scent. It leaves the skin feeling refreshed with a kind of “glow”, especially if you have dry skin.

This is another wonderful toner by MEDICUBE. It’s a multi-peptide toner, that is soothing on the skin and hydrating. It does a great job of keeping oiliness at bay while keeping my skin moisturized. It doesn’t strip my skin from of all natural oils or leave my skin dry. It’s effectively evening my skin tone. I highly recommend.

This is a great toner for these windy, dry days. It is very moisturizing but not sticky. I feel my skin looks brighter after using it. I like its nice, subtle scent. But I wish it came in a spray bottle. It would be much easier to use.
